name: Nemean
based: Dimebag's Randall rigs, one capture per Pantera album
intro: Nemean is new, in the spirit of Pantera: black diamond tread plate with four claw slashes torn right through it and lit from behind, a polished chrome name over the top. COWBOYS, VULGAR, DRIVEN and TRENDKILL pick the album, and the light behind the slashes, the strip and the power lamp change to that album's colour.
notes: One capture per album, each a full rig (amp and cab), so the plugin's cab is bypassed on this amp.
COWBOYS, VULGAR, DRIVEN and TRENDKILL pick the album. Each album remembers its own Gain, EQ and Tight.
Gain drives the input into the capture; Bass, Middle, Treble and Presence are a tone stack around it, Tight trims the low end before the amp.

0.name: Cowboys From Hell
0.note: Cowboys From Hell (1990): the rawest of the four, more mids and bite.

1.name: Vulgar Display of Power
1.note: Vulgar Display of Power (1992), the Walk tone: the famous scooped, tight Dime crunch.

2.name: Far Beyond Driven
2.note: Far Beyond Driven (1994), the I'm Broken tone: heavier, more gain and low end.

3.name: The Great Southern Trendkill
3.note: The Great Southern Trendkill (1996): the darkest and most saturated.
